scope: VB TextBox multiline, scroll, read-only, password and alignment boundary.
actual_source_basis: The original VB5 and VB6 XP Styles Demonstration forms contain a TextBox with MultiLine=True and ScrollBars=Both alongside a normal single-line TextBox.
The ImageProcessor source uses Locked TextBox instances, confirming that user editing state must remain native runtime/EDIT behavior.
renderer_boundary: Exact runtime-owned ThunderRT5/6TextBox uses the existing EDIT control path. A multiline child gets early theme capture and the existing classic scrollbar path; text storage, selection, Undo, password character, alignment, readonly and IME remain native EDIT responsibilities.

current_witness.x64_injected: VB_TEXTBOX_VARIANTS_OK multiline=1 scroll=1 undo=1 readonly=1 password=1 center=1 native_retire=1
current_witness.x86_injected: VB_TEXTBOX_VARIANTS_OK multiline=1 scroll=1 undo=1 readonly=1 password=1 center=1 native_retire=1
current_witness.native_controls: x64/x86 bare fixtures retain native EDIT behavior and no renderer attachment.

semantic_correction: EM_REPLACESEL is an application/programmatic edit and remains allowed on a read-only Windows EDIT. The regression therefore verifies that WM_CHAR is rejected after EM_SETREADONLY while programmatic API semantics are left unchanged.
result: S24 adds test-only coverage; production path already supplies the safe classic border/font/scrollbar adaptation without rewriting EDIT text semantics.
not_covered: IME composition on a physical desktop.
